name: Bolter Island-Mississippi River
about: Bolter Island-Mississippi River drains about 24 square miles, 67% of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 650 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 420 feet at its lowest. It includes part of St. Charles. Downstream, its water passes through the Marais Temps Clair-Mississippi River, City of Alton-Mississippi River and City of Wood River-Mississippi River watersheds on its way down the Mississippi River.
